name: drafting-sheet-skill
description: An agent skill for interactive 3D how-it-works pages in a white engineering-drawing style: ink-outlined three.js machines you can slow down, step, scrub and orbit, with numbered labels, live readouts and a cycle chart. Ships an engine and a bike pump, plus a 60 fps walkthrough-clip recorder.
